title: Privacy and Utility Evaluation of Synthetic Data for Multi-State Time-to-Event Applications
summary: A master's thesis repository implementing and evaluating synthetic-data generators and privacy/utility metrics for multi-state time-to-event (survival) data such as liver cirrhosis progression. It uses SDV's PARSynthesizer, run via the sdv.sequential API with a SingleTableMetadata object, to fit and generate sequential synthetic patient trajectories.
